Excluding pinned nodes from the max is also correct and correctly justified in the docstring (:145-147).
instruments.evidence: Two real gaps rather than defects. (1) The NMII residual is measured (residual_nmii_pN) but is NOT included in residual_over_tension (:519-520), so the convergence verdict ignores one of the two relaxed arrays; committed values 0.0395 (SF) vs 0.0267 (NMII). (2) The larger issue is systemic, not local: the same physical actin backbone is a hard constraint in ac/cell (residual = max|PF|) and a spring in ac/engine/sf_mechanics (residual = max|F|), with two different tension definitions (reconstructed Lagrange λ vs k(L−r0)) and no cross-calibration on disk. When cortex and SF are CONNECTED — the PI's stated #1 priority — the tension crossing that connector will be measured by two instruments with different conventions and there is no test that they agree.
instruments.negative_control_that_would_catch_it: Build one identical filament configuration under both models, sweep k_axial upward, and require k(L−r0) → the cortex lane's λ within tolerance. Independently: include the NMII array in the convergence ratio and confirm the verdict does not change.
instruments.canonical_replacement: A shared residual reporter that takes the constraint set as an argument and returns (max_raw_F, max_projected_PF, max_constraint_error) per component, so both lanes report the same triple and the composed cell has a per-component convergence table instead of one scalar.

instruments.name: ac/solid/adhesion_clutch — the explicit integrin clutch force law
instruments.what_its_name_implies: The substrate traction load path — explicit two-sided actin↔collagen clutch with Newton reaction.
instruments.what_it_actually_measures: Exactly that, as a FORCE LAW. What is absent is the OBSERVABLE built on it: nothing reduces the clutch bond forces into a traction field, a traction resultant, or a contractile moment, and no run composes the clutch with the SF/cortex lanes that currently use a Dirichlet pin instead.
instruments.evidence: The clutch exists and is documented as two-sided with the exact Newton reaction (:6, :22, :86). But the only traction NUMBER anywhere in the tree comes from a Dirichlet reaction (entry _fa_traction), and a grep for any build-time guard preventing a node from being both pinned and clutch-attached returns nothing. So the mechanistic instrument the PI's baseline needs is built but not instrumented, while the artifact instrument is the one being reported.
instruments.negative_control_that_would_catch_it: Once the traction reduction exists: sweep collagen stiffness over 3 decades and require traction to change monotonically (a rigid pin gives invariance); and require Σ(clutch force on cell) + Σ(clutch force on ECM) = 0 exactly, per connector.
instruments.canonical_replacement: Add a traction reduction over engaged clutch bonds emitting (resultant, contractile moment, per-area traction over the measured contact footprint) into the ledger, plus a disjointness assertion pinned_mask ∧ clutch_mask = ∅.

magnitude_free_oracles: SIGNED-MEAN γ WITH ACROSS-PLANE SCATTER. Replace mean|γ_n| with (signed mean, sd across planes) and require |mean|/sd >> 1. Measured discriminator: a zero-tension network gives 0.07, a genuinely tensed one 6.0–52. Costs nothing, restores sign-sense, converts the unknown rectification floor into a reported number, and needs no parameter magnitude.

TENSION-SIGN REVERSAL. Negate every element tension and require γ to change sign. Currently all-T=+1 and all-T=−1 both return 0.3560 pN/µm, so a fully buckled cortex is indistinguishable from a tensed one. Pure sign-sense, no magnitudes.

TWO-ENDED AXIAL-TENSION RECONSTRUCTION. Compute the actin axial tension from BOTH filament ends and report max|T_A − reverse(T_B)|, which equals |Σ f_ext| per filament. Zero at equilibrium; measured 32.6 % of the tension at a 0.1398 pN/node residual. Turns 'is this tension or transient?' into an arithmetic identity.

OBLATE-DEFORMATION INVARIANCE OF γ. Flatten the cell at fixed per-element tension and require γ invariant. Currently moves 32 % over aspect 1→2 because R is an input. This is the acceptance test the adherent 2D-collagen baseline needs before any γ can be quoted on a spread cell.

SIGNED RADIAL RESIDUAL BIAS S = Σ(PF_i · r̂_i), reported as γ_spur/γ_target = S/(8πR·γ_target). Grid-invariant (contains neither N nor ell) and Π₀-invariant in relative form. It is the only quantity that bounds the error on the reported observable; the arithmetic shows the current gate permits 367 pN/µm of spurious γ at its PASS value.

CONNECTOR ADJOINTNESS: |F_sideA + F_sideB|² per connector, plus work conjugacy W_A + W_B ≈ 0. This is the check the ledger claims to perform and does not. Dimensionless when normalised by max(|F_A|,|F_B|); no parameter needed.

MOMENT CLOSURE Στ = Σ x × F ≈ 0 for a free cell, and the contractile moment P = Σ(x·â)(F·â) for an adherent one. Force balance alone is identically satisfied by any dipole; the moment channel is the only thing that can see one, and neither exists.

SUBSTRATE-STIFFNESS SWEEP AS A CONSTRAINT DETECTOR. A real clutch traction must depend on substrate stiffness; a Dirichlet pin's reaction is invariant to it by construction. Three decades of k_ECM, monotonicity only — no magnitude claim, and it cleanly separates physical traction from constraint artifact.

RIGID-ROD LIMIT CROSS-CALIBRATION: sweep the SF lane's k_axial upward on a fixed configuration and require its k(L−r0) tension to converge to the cortex lane's Lagrange λ. Tests that the tree's two incompatible actin backbone models agree in their common limit — a prerequisite for measuring anything across a cortex↔SF connector.

GRID REFINEMENT OF THE STRESS FIELD: double node count at fixed physical state and require the virial σ to be invariant. It currently halves, because node_vol = V0/Nc. Pure grid-invariance, no parameters.

VACUOUS-GUARD SWEEP: for every boolean in every verdict dict, assert that the predicate was actually exercised (fail, do not pass, when the sample is empty). The GATE-B causal guard `... else True` returned a printed PASS on a trace containing no unbound step.

MOP-VERSUS-LAPLACE CALIBRATION ON A KNOWN SHELL: an analytically pressurised shell must give MOP γ_total = Π₀R/2 within the reported across-plane sd. Both sides scale with Π₀, so the RATIO is magnitude-free — and it is the one legitimate use of Young-Laplace as an oracle rather than an observable.
missing_instruments: The signed radial residual bias S = Σ(PF_i · r̂_i). It exists in no code and no artifact, and it is the only candidate that bounds contamination of the reported γ. Without it, max|PF| < 0.21 pN certifies a minimiser, not a measurement.

max|PF| itself in the production run record. The committed native artifact carries only raw |F| (2634.1 / 1483.1 / 2634.1) plus the displacement and constraint limbs — so the ONE convergence limb that actually failed has no recorded value and the gate cannot be evaluated from any committed run.

A moment channel in GlobalCellLedger. Three LedgerContributor docstrings promise 'force, moment, work' and there is no moment accumulator. A force resultant is identically zero for any dipole, so the engine's only conservation gate is blind to the contractile state.

A per-connector adjointness reduction. Every architectural claim rests on connectors being bidirectional + adjoint, and no instrument tests it. The existing reaction+traction gate is an ECM-side identity that a broken adjoint would pass.

A ratified tolerance for assemble_balance. tol_sq_d is None in every slice, transaction.py skips the gate when it is None, and the committed GATE-B run force-accepts every step. The gate has never executed.

A real traction observable: per-area traction over the measured contact footprint, the traction resultant, and the contractile moment [pN·µm], reduced from explicit clutch bond forces. The clutch force law exists; the observable does not.
A build-time disjointness assertion that no node is both Dirichlet-pinned and clutch-attached. This is the PI's own named double-counting trap and there is no guard anywhere in ac/.

A per-component residual/convergence table for the composed cell. The current single max|PF| is taken over a set that mixes projected fiber nodes with unprojected membrane and nucleus nodes, so it cannot say which compartment failed — the exact question the PI's connect-the-compartments priority will ask every run.
A recorded per-element tension scatter, so the MOP rectification floor can be evaluated against the reported γ instead of being unknown.
A cortex↔SF tension cross-calibration in the k_axial → ∞ limit. Two incompatible actin backbone models with two incompatible tension definitions are live simultaneously.
The actin inextensibility (Lagrange) tension as a carrier in the virial stress field, and a mesh-derived node volume. Both are needed before any per-node stress field in Pa can be quoted.

A tension/traction reading protocol keyed to convergence: no magnitude may be emitted unless the state passed its own residual gate. GATE-B already does this correctly by BLOCKING its quantitative verdict — it should be a shared harness rule, not one script's discipline.
open_questions_for_pi: γ_network = 3.7043 pN/µm is the flagship emergent-tension number, and three independent contaminations of it are unquantified: the MOP rectification floor at native element counts is 1.3–2.7 pN/µm per 1 pN of per-element tension scatter (scatter unrecorded); the actin-tension reconstruction is end-biased by exactly the unbalanced force per filament (max|PF| plateaus near 0.5 pN, 2.4× the static gate); and γ_source is 0.0191, i.e. the actual power stroke is 0.5 % of the quoted number. Decision: does the 3.70 stand as a reported observable, or is it withdrawn pending the signed-mean estimator and a converged state? All three repairs are magnitude-free and cheap.

The |F| → |PF| change is physically CORRECT and I confirm it independently (rigid modes lie in null(J), so no genuine unbalanced force or torque can be projected away; |C| = 1.1e-16 is co-gated; projector conditioning is benign, cond(JJᵀ) = 19 / 681 / 6.5e4 at 500 / 75 / 8 nm giving float64 errors ≤ 1.4e-11, so it is NOT the fine-mesh plateau). But the correction never reached the production driver: _residual_host and every driver record still report raw |F| under the name 'residual', and scripts/ac_residual_by_command_block compares raw |F| against the |PF| gate. Ratify a naming contract (residual_raw_* vs residual_projected_*) and a per-component norm, since the SF lane's Hookean backbone makes raw |F| the CORRECT norm there — two lanes, two correct norms, one shared name today.

The FA 'traction' is a Dirichlet reaction, not a clutch traction: no integrin, no bond lifetime, no substrate compliance, no area, and its magnitude is 30 % contaminated by the unconverged residual. Its SIGN test (100 % inward) is legitimate and worth keeping. Decision: rename the field to fa_dirichlet_reaction_pN now, and ratify that the traction claim waits for the explicit clutch on a compliant collagen body plus a contractile-moment reduction. Also ratify the disjointness guard (pinned ∧ clutched = ∅) BEFORE the compartments are connected, because that is when the double-count goes live.

γ = ΔP·R/2: the answer splits by engine. In ac/ it is used only as a TARGET against an independently measured MOP γ — sound, and the pattern the rest of the family should copy. In ff/ it IS the observable: gamma_apparent_pN_um = 0.5·dP·R_eq at network_warp.py:1289/1415/1793 is the Young-Laplace identity on its own input, it produced the 0.150 mN/m 'interphase match' and the 'confinement-independent γ' result across three closeout docs, and the same lines compute the measured plate pressure dP_force and do not use it. Same class as the 120.0000-degree gate. Decision: retract or re-label those ff/ results, and switch the observable to dP_force·R_eq/2.

The ledger's global force-balance gate is a triple hole: it is an ECM-side identity that a non-adjoint connector would pass; no tolerance exists anywhere on disk; and it has never executed because every committed step is force-accepted. It is the engine's ONLY conservation gate and the PI's #1 priority is mechanical connectedness. Decision: ratify (a) the per-connector adjointness form, (b) a moment channel, (c) a tolerance, before any component is promoted past CONNECTED.

The GATE-B causal guard tension_zero_while_no_head_is_bound was reported as a MECHANISM PASS without ever being evaluated — `... if unbound_steps.any() else True`, and the committed trace has no unbound step. This is the largest-fragment gate pattern again. Decision: make the vacuous branch a hard failure, and authorise a sweep of every verdict dict in the tree for the same shape.

ff/ff_virial_stress.cortex_node_stress has a sign convention on its bond term that is the negation of the turgor term in the SAME tensor (a +5 pN tensile bond gives σ_xx = −2.5 Pa while ΔP=40 gives pressure=+40), it omits the dominant load path (actin constraint tension) and bending, and its Pa magnitude is set by node_vol = V0/Nc. σ_vm is invariant under σ → −σ so no existing viewer can see the sign error. Decision: is this field still load-bearing for any claim, or does it get fixed-and-renamed to crosslink_myosin_node_stress?

The one thing in the tree named a 'traction dipole' (_anchor_dipole) returns max(|R_hi|,|R_lo|) — a force in pN, not a moment in pN·µm — while the absence of a crawl force dipole is one of only two headline deficits that survived adversarial reading. Decision: authorise the contractile-moment reduction as the canonical dipole observable and rename the incumbent.

Two incompatible mechanical models of one physical object are live: the actin backbone is a rigid NF2007 constraint in ac/cell and a Hookean k_axial spring in ac/engine/sf_mechanics (whose own docstring notes NF2007 treats it as inextensible and that no sourced EA_actin exists). This forces two residual norms and two tension definitions across any cortex↔SF connector. Decision: which model is canonical, and does the k_axial → ∞ cross-calibration gate the SF component's promotion?

The MOP γ instrument is protocol-mismatched for the PI's own stated baseline (adherent, spread, 2D collagen): R is an input constant and the element set is label-blind, so the same physical tension reads 32 % lower on an oblate cell and 20 interior fibres at 50 pN inflate 'cortical' γ by 1,473 %. The demotion to cross-check was recommended on 2026-06-07 and never landed. Decision: land the geometric cut-length and the component-ID filter, or accept that no γ may be quoted on an adherent cell.

One record-level inconsistency I could not resolve from disk and will not guess at: the committed native artifact reports inner_max_displacement_um = 3.87e-15 (five orders below its 7.45e-9 tolerance) simultaneously with a raw residual of 1483 pN and inner_converged = False. With inner_dt_mu = 3.54e-8 µm/pN, a residual of that size should move nodes ~5e-5 µm. Either the descent is stalled at machine precision because the NF2007 reshape cancels the projected step (in which case the displacement limb carries no information and the entire convergence gate rests on the unrecorded max|PF|), or the displacement reduction is measuring the wrong pair of arrays. Both are consequential and the record cannot distinguish them. Needs one native run with max|PF| recorded.

result.method:
DESIGN 1 — Neural surrogate / SBI, re-scoped by arithmetic, shipped enforcement-first.

(a) CLASS. Primary = hierarchical/factorized Neural Ratio Estimator (NRE), trained per compartment-block, summing per-observable log-ratios. NPE only as a sequential proposal distribution. REJECT the direct forward emulator theta->y as primary.

Why NRE here: its output type is a relative plausibility over theta. It never emits a predicted observable, so it cannot be mistaken for a measurement, cannot be dropped into a physics loop, and has no scalar that reads like gamma = 3.7 pN/um. A forward emulator emits exactly that kind of number, and this project's dominant failure is a number that reads as a measurement but is not (7 metric mislabels; a headline fingerprint that survived a dP/gamma swap byte-identically). NRE also matches the long-run target: many independent published macroscopic data points become a SUM of log-ratios = the natural hierarchical-Bayes factorization. Its log-ratio magnitude doubles as an OOD signal (flat everywhere = uninformative; huge everywhere = OOD). NPE is more sample-efficient at test time but is documented overconfident and emits something that reads like an answer, so it stays a proposal generator.

(b) PARAMETER VECTOR — read off disk, not invented.
UNIVERSAL MOLECULAR LAYER: ffn_sim/ac/motor/params_i0b3.yaml (verified: 12 of 19 entries are value: null, evidence_status GAP - PI) plus the card clusters in ffn_sim/docs/v2_audit/PI_GAP_EVIDENCE_CARDS_2026-07-25.md — NMII N1-N9 (9), ERM E1-E5 (5), MT M1-M3 (3), IF I1-I2 (2), filopodium F1-F5 (5), lamellipodium L1-L4 (4), SF S1 (1), LINC C1-C4 (4), FA card A1 (~4 constants). ~37 contested molecular quantities; largest single block d=9 (NMII).
PER-CELL COMPOSITION LAYER: the schema already exists as ffn_sim/ff/cell_type.py::CellTypeProfile (R_um, eta_Pa_s, E_nuc_Pa + migration knobs), with MDA-MB-231 documented as the mesenchymal organisation plus 3 of ~7 mechanical axes. Add densities/counts: cortex areal density, MT count n_mt (card M3), ERM rho_0 (E5), NPF rho_NPF (L4), filaments/bundle (F4), turgor Pi_0 (T1). ~12-15 per-cell.
FIXED (not inferred): 124 KU-tagged numeric constants measured across 28 config YAMLs; those with SOURCED provenance enter as tight priors or are frozen. The 70 items in coverage_baseline.yaml params-debt are the audit-flagged undeclared subset and must be declared before any of them can be a prior.
So d_theta ~ 50 as tight priors + ~37 genuinely free, block-factorized to d<=9 per block. A single joint 85-dim NRE/NPE is not attempted — see cost arithmetic.

(c) SUMMARY STATISTICS. Admit only magnitude-free, grid-invariant, accepted-step-sourced quantities:
1. Newton-3rd / adjoint-work closure residuals per connector (dimensionless ratio). Already implemented in ac/fluid/coupled_boundary_reference.py adjoint_work_residual, ac/engine/linc_connector.py:887, tests/ac/engine/test_fluid_core.py:733.
2. Global force-balance residual ratio |reaction+traction| / max(|reaction|,|traction|) from GlobalCellLedger.assemble_balance (ledger.py:329) — dimensionless, so magnitude-free.
3. Sign-sense booleans/fractions: FA reaction INWARD fraction (already measured 100%), bipolar dot (geometric identity -1), radial residual bias sign.
4. Scaling exponents: dObservable/dlog(mesh h), dgamma/dlog(rho_myosin), dtraction/dlog(E_ECM). Exponents are magnitude-free by construction and are the correct target when magnitudes are explicitly not the gate.
5. Analytic-oracle ratios: gamma_measured / (dP*R/2); ERM spectrum vs erm_spectrum_analytic.py; Young-Laplace closure.
6. Intensive mechanical observables: gamma via ff/gamma_estimator.py method_of_planes_gamma (force/length, divided by 2*pi*R => intensive), per-node virial von-Mises stress from ff/ff_virial_stress.py (Pa; sigma = (1/V)*sum 0.5*(r x f), nonzero at equilibrium, unlike a residual), areal strain from the fixed triangulation.
7. Reciprocity/symmetry: tangent-operator symmetry residual (already asserted in the implicit audit), rotation-invariance of the Q-tensor detector (ac emergence firewall).
FORBIDDEN as summaries: (i) max|PF| — GATE_A_THRESHOLD_DERIVATION_2026-07-25.md measures it as non-grid-invariant (500nm 0.14, 200nm 0.21, 75nm 3.42; superlinear over 6.7x refinement) and as a float64 round-off criterion (float32 recompile gives 4882 pN, x23170); a program whose purpose is inference across configurations cannot target it. (ii) any A/A0 outside the PI-ratified top-down xy silhouette — verify_runs.FORBIDDEN_METRICS already auto-RETRACTs basal/footprint/convex-hull. (iii) raw |F| (contains backbone Lagrange tension: raw 5.7892 = |J^T lambda| 4.4820 + max|PF| 1.7399). (iv) any observable whose evaluation needs a PI-GAP magnitude.
MISSING and required: GlobalCellLedger has NO moment channel and NO centroid channel (grep confirms; ecm_world.py:346 already promises a moment the ledger cannot accept). Without them the traction dipole and translocation are ungateable, so the crawl-side summaries do not exist yet.

(d) TRAINING SET AND WHERE THE RUNS COME FROM — see cost_arithmetic. Short form: block surrogates train on per-compartment slice runs (~5,000/block x 10 blocks = 50,000 slice-sims); native full-population composed runs are the SMALL expensive set (~1,000-1,400 3-seed points in a 3-month 50%-duty A5000 allocation) used only to (i) calibrate a low-dimensional multi-fidelity discrepancy term and (ii) adjudicate every claim. Long native trajectories are rejected: the longest native trajectory ever executed is 40 accepted steps (ROLLING_ROADMAP.md:139).

(e) UNCERTAINTY CALIBRATION — five layers, four statistical and one external.
1. SBC rank-histogram uniformity over >=1,000 held-out prior draws per block; non-uniform => the block is unusable, gate refuses.
2. Expected-coverage / TARP diagnostic at 68/90/95; require empirical coverage >= nominal (conservative only). This is the specific check that catches confidently-wrong NPE/NRE.
3. OOD refusal, two-sided: (i) marginal log-density log q(y) below the alpha=0.01 quantile of the training set => refuse; (ii) per-coordinate range check, because a high-dim density is blind to a single-coordinate excursion.
4. Deep ensemble: 5 independently-seeded estimators; pairwise posterior symmetric-KL above a declared cap => refuse. Ensemble disagreement is the only OOD signal that does not itself assume in-distribution.
5. THE ONE THAT ACTUALLY COUNTS: native adjudication scoreboard. Layers 1-4 are self-referential — they score the estimator against the same simulator that trained it, and here that simulator is a SLICE, not the native cell. Only native adjudication is external. So the reported calibration number is the empirical native-vs-surrogate hit rate and the worst native/surrogate ratio ever observed, printed on every make kb-check.
Plus a per-parameter prior->posterior CONTRACTION report (posterior sd / prior sd). Any parameter below a declared contraction threshold is reported NOT INFERRED and the gate refuses to let it be quoted. This is the most likely route to a false claim: with ~37 free parameters and ~10^3 native points, most coordinates will be prior-dominated, and if the prior comes from the same literature the result is compared against, the inference is circular.

(f) GRADIENTS — evaluated, and the answer is no. See failure_modes and the variance arithmetic in cost_arithmetic. Summary: REINFORCE/score-function is out by ~4,600 GPU-years; Gumbel-softmax/straight-through is rejected on the hard rule before variance is considered (a fractional bound head is a mean-field occupancy with no barycentric attachment point — exactly the aggregate substitute ac/engine/nmii_actuator.py:460-482 refuses at construction); measure-valued differentiation is finite-variance but costs 170 coupled solves per gradient (~44 h) and 10^2-10^3 gradients. The one gradient-adjacent thing that IS practical is common-random-numbers finite differences as a NATIVE SENSITIVITY INSTRUMENT (170 solves, ~44 h, once) — and it may retire the surrogate entirely by showing the effective dimension is 10-15, not 85.
result.what_it_buys:
Three distinct things, only one of which is the surrogate.

1. IMMEDIATE, no surrogate needed: the CRN sensitivity instrument (Phase 1) answers "which of the ~37 free parameters does each Family-1-5 observable actually depend on" for 170 native solves (~44 h on the A5000). Any parameter an observable is provably insensitive to is RETIRED from the magnitude gate without being sourced. Given the PI has 33+ open PI-GAP card slots and has explicitly deprioritised magnitudes, this converts an unsourced-parameter blocker into a measured non-dependence — which is exactly a magnitude-free measurement. This is the highest value-per-GPU-hour item in the whole design and it needs no neural network.

2. MEDIUM TERM: block-factorized NRE over the ~37 free molecular parameters gives a PROPOSAL distribution — a ranked, uncertainty-quantified ordering of which parameter combinations are worth spending a 940 s native solve on. At ~1,400 affordable native composed points per quarter, choosing which 1,400 to run is the actual binding decision. A calibrated proposal is worth roughly the ratio of informative-to-uninformative runs it avoids; even a 3x improvement in run selection is 3 months of A5000 recovered per year.

3. LONG TERM (the PI's stated purpose): parameters as OUTPUTS. Per-parameter prior->posterior contraction is the honest deliverable — it says which molecular constants published macroscopic data can and cannot pin down. Reporting "this parameter is NOT identifiable from any available macroscopic observable" is a real scientific result and is publishable, and it is the same artifact that protects against laundering an unidentified parameter into a config.

What it does NOT buy: a faster path to a validated physics claim. Every claim still costs a native solve. The surrogate reduces the number of native solves needed to find the right claim; it never reduces the number needed to establish one.
prerequisites: P0 (BLOCKING, ships before any model code): the enforcement gate. verify_surrogate.py + surrogate_ledger.yaml + the evidence_origin required field + the import firewall + the negative-control fixture, all wired blocking into make kb-check and .github/workflows/ci.yml. Reason: there must never exist a window in which a surrogate number can enter results_manifest.yaml. Intention-based discipline has failed 6 times (M5) and today's adversarial pass returned CONFIRMED 0 of 7 on new guards.

P1 (BLOCKING for any training label): one composed lane that CONVERGES under a physical acceptance predicate. Today ComposedNativeCell.solve_candidate (composed_native.py:347-359) runs run_candidate() once and never updates a position; accepted_d = ones; net 2 of 32 connectors dispatched and the composed world has never been stepped on CUDA (AUDIT_AC_ENGINE_2026-07-25 section 1). Without a converging coupled solve every training label is a relaxation transient — which is exactly why the nmii_sf_motor magnitude was correctly withheld at residual/tension = 15.5%.

P2 (PI DECISION, blocks every label): the assemble_balance acceptance tolerance. A declared tolerance value exists nowhere in code or docs. The ledger deliberately takes it as a caller-supplied device scalar (ledger.py:329, no magic number baked in) — so someone must declare it, and it is a gate-contract change.

P3 (BLOCKING for crawl/traction observables): a moment channel and a centroid channel on GlobalCellLedger. Confirmed absent (no grep hit for moment in ledger.py) while ecm_world.py:346 already promises to contribute one. Until they exist, the cell moves forward is ungateable and traction-dipole cannot be a training target.

P4 (BLOCKING for a training set at all): every driver writes a typed JSON artifact with config, population, per-step telemetry including a t0 row, residual and residual/tension, parameter provenance, and verdict. Three of five GATE-B drivers currently persist nothing; the GATE-A closure numbers 0.1398/0.1416/0.1586 exist only in prose. You cannot build a training set from prose.

P5 (BLOCKING for the cost case): a MEASURED slice-sim wall time. I could find none on disk. The entire feasibility argument for the block surrogates rests on it. Measure the sf_arc / cortex_motor / erm slices and commit the number before committing to the plan.
P6 (free, do it): native A/B and default-on for FIX1 (cg_check_every early-exit, BIT-IDENTICAL, 5.3x). Bit-identical means it needs no fidelity argument. It is currently default-off pending an A/B.

P7 (PI RULING, blocks Phase 3+): does SBI against published macroscopic data violate no fitting to PI experimental data? Literature-first says probably not, but SBI IS fitting. The boundary needs an explicit ruling before any inference code exists, not after.
concrete_plan: PHASE 0 — ENFORCEMENT FIRST (about 1 week, CPU only, no model code). 0a. ffn_sim/outputs/tag_kb/verify_surrogate.py, mirroring verify_runs.py / verify_params.py / verify_gate_contracts.py exactly (pure stdlib + PyYAML, committed artifacts only, exit 1 on drift). 0b. Add a REQUIRED orthogonal field evidence_origin in {NATIVE_CUDA, SURROGATE, CPU_REFERENCE, ANALYTIC_ORACLE} to every claim-bearing artifact and to every results_manifest.yaml row. Do NOT extend verify_runs.SUSPICION (RETRACT 0 / NEEDS_REGEN 1 / GPU_UNREPRODUCED 2 / VERIFIED 3) — that ladder measures disk-vs-claim drift, and folding evidence origin into it would conflate two dimensions, which is itself the mislabel pattern. Instead add the hard rule: declared VERIFIED REQUIRES evidence_origin == NATIVE_CUDA. A surrogate claim is structurally incapable of reaching VERIFIED. 0c. For evidence_origin: SURROGATE require a sub-record: model_id (sha256 of weights), training_manifest path, native_anchor_runs list, in_distribution {log_p_y, alpha_quantile, verdict}, calibration {sbc_pvalue, expected_coverage_90}, contraction {per-parameter posterior_sd/prior_sd}, and decides: false (literal). 0d. Canonical TYPED hash: hash over ordered (field_name, unit, value) triples, units mandatory. Ship the refutation fixture that proves it: swap dP=40 Pa and gamma=10 pN/um and assert the hash CHANGES — the exact swap that a sorted-deduplicated-bare-numeric-token fingerprint survived byte-identically today. CI fails if the negative control passes. 0e. Import firewall: create ffn_sim/infer/ (surrogate lives here, outside the runtime tree). ffn_sim/infer/ may import ac/; ac/** may NOT import ffn_sim.infer. Enforce statically by extending the AST scan in ffn_sim/tests/ac/test_warp_only_contract.py (which already does exactly this for hoomd) plus a conftest.py meta_path blocker mirroring _install_hoomd_blocker() at conftest.py:232-279. Same mechanism the project already uses for the two other runtime-import bans (hoomd, validation/oracles). 0f. Add INFERRED to forces_manifest.PROVENANCE (currently SOURCED, DERIVED, CONVENIENCE, PI_GAP) and rank it strictly below DERIVED in verify_params.py, so a config running on an inferred value can never be declared physiological baseline. 0g. Unit-test the gate logic in ffn_sim/tests/ac/test_kb_integrity_gates.py next to the existing three, and add a blocking CI job.

PHASE 1 — CRN SENSITIVITY (native, about 2 weeks A5000, 170 solves, no surrogate). Freeze the Poisson clock uniforms (common random numbers) and take 2-point finite differences in each of the ~37 free parameters against every Family-1-5 observable. Deliverable: a sensitivity matrix committed as a typed JSON artifact, plus a per-parameter verdict OBSERVABLE_INSENSITIVE / SENSITIVE / UNMEASURED. Gate consequence: an INSENSITIVE parameter is removed from the magnitude blocker list for that observable, with the measurement as evidence. Decision point: if the effective dimension is 10-15, a direct native sweep beats any surrogate and Phases 3-5 are cancelled. This phase can REJECT the rest of the design, which is why it goes first.

PHASE 2 — OBSERVABLE CONTRACT (about 1 week, CPU). Register every candidate summary in ffn_sim/docs/v2_audit/gate_contracts/ with observable.id, definition, units, reduction, plus two NEW required fields: grid_invariance_evidence (measured at >=2 mesh rungs, with the numbers) and magnitude_free (bool). verify_surrogate.py fails if a training-manifest observable id is absent from any contract or if its definition string differs — reusing the contract-hash + substitution_watch machinery that already exists to catch observable substitution (M2, 4 recurrences). Explicitly blacklist max|PF| as a surrogate summary and record why (non-grid-invariant: 0.14/0.21/3.42 over 500/200/75 nm). Emit the summary vector ONLY from the accepted-step ledger, never from a driver-side host computation.

PHASE 3 — BLOCK SURROGATES ON SLICES (blocked on P0, P1, P5, P7; ~3 weeks + ~18 GPU-days). Ten per-compartment blocks, d_theta <= 9 each, using the EXISTING harness: ac/engine/ensemble.py EnsembleRunner already provides seed-spawned reproducible realizations (np.random.SeedSequence(base_seed).spawn), RealizationResult, ObservableDistribution.within_band, and mix_ensembles for state-conditioned mixtures — it is CPU-importable, does no physics, and is exactly the right shape. Train a factorized NRE per block. Run SBC + expected-coverage + OOD + 5-member ensemble for each. A block that fails any calibration layer is marked NON_INFORMATIVE and the gate refuses to let it propose.

PHASE 4 — MULTI-FIDELITY DISCREPANCY (blocked on P1-P4; ~1,000-1,400 native 3-seed points, about 1 quarter at 50% duty). Calibrate a LOW-dimensional (order 10^2 effective parameters) discrepancy term between slice-block predictions and native composed observables. Report the discrepancy magnitude per observable. HARD rule: if the native-vs-slice discrepancy exceeds the posterior width for a parameter, that parameter is declared NON_INFORMATIVE and the gate says so. This is the mechanical answer to M5 (6 documented coarse-contradicted-by-native cases): the discrepancy is measured and reported rather than assumed small. Report per-parameter prior->posterior contraction; anything under threshold is NOT INFERRED.

PHASE 5 — ADJUDICATION LOOP (continuous). The estimator's public API is a SurrogateVerdict dataclass with NO scalar accessor: no .value, no .prediction. The only method that returns something usable is .propose_native_run() -> a runnable native config. On OOD it raises OutOfDistribution and the only legal continuation is a native run. Every proposal is entered in surrogate_ledger.yaml with its prediction; every native outcome is entered against it. Two numbers print on every make kb-check: adjudicated count and worst native/surrogate ratio ever observed. RATCHET: unadjudicated surrogate claims may not exceed 3x the adjudicated count, else the gate turns RED. That rate-limits the surrogate's licence to speak by native adjudication throughput — the piece intention-based discipline structurally lacks.
result.cost_arithmetic:
MEASURED on-disk wall times (all cited, all full native 70,686 filaments / 494,802 actin nodes on one A5000 16GB):
- build: 7.166 s (outputs/ac/foundation-hardening/REPORT.md:125) and 9.683 s (outputs/ac/resting_native/resting_native_probe_2026-07-23.json).
- explicit inner iteration, cortex force set, WCA on: 0.02271 s/iter (outputs/ac/implicit/REPORT.md 20-iteration table).
- explicit inner iteration, FULL compartment stack (494,802 actin + 655,362 membrane + nucleus + fluid + monomer): 171.890 s / 400 iters = 0.4297 s/iter; whole outer step incl. build = 182.476 s; inner_converged = false, outer_rolled_back = true.
- best accelerated: 0.82235 s/iter (tournament RKC s=8); 1.32612 s/iter with the rigid-fiber Schwarz block.
- one 200-iteration accelerated solve: 163.586 s, ends on a 38.86 pN plateau, converged = false.
- one 6000-iteration k_xb probe: 1274.588 s (outputs/ac/resting_native/kxb_sensitivity.json), converged = false.
- fine 75 nm (2.90 M nodes), 40 outers: 568 s (MG off) / 1463 s (MG on).

DISCREPANCY I MUST FLAG: the brief's anchor (938 s = build 7.5 s + 4.69 s/iter x ~200) is NOT reproducible from any artifact I could find. Nearest on-disk analogues are 163.6 s for 200 accelerated iterations at 0.818 s/iter, and 1274.6 s for 6000 iterations. 938 s does sit inside the measured 180-1300 s bracket, so it is a defensible planning anchor, but a design whose economics rest on an unverifiable wall-time number reproduces the exact failure class this audit exists for. I use C_solve = 940 s below and mark it PARENT-ASSERTED, UNVERIFIED.

ONE A5000 = 86,400 s/day.
- at C_solve = 940 s: 92 solves/day.
- with FIX1 only (5.3x, BIT-IDENTICAL): 177 s -> 488 solves/day.
- with FIX1+FIX2 (~40x): 23.5 s -> 3,677 solves/day. ASYMMETRY THAT MUST BE RATIFIED: FIX2 (assembled per-fiber coarse) is NOT bit-identical and is unratified, so it may accelerate the EXPLORER (training set, declared non-authoritative by construction) but must NEVER accelerate the DECIDER (native adjudication).

WHY THE FULL-CELL TRAJECTORY EMULATOR IS REJECTED:
- dt_phys = 0.05 s (resting probe); published spreading/traction/migration data spans 10^2-10^4 s. Take 600 s of cell time = 12,000 accepted steps.
- 12,000 x 940 s = 1.128e7 s = 130.6 GPU-days PER TRAJECTORY. With 40x: 3.26 GPU-days per trajectory.
- An NPE/NRE training set of 10^3 trajectories = 3,260 GPU-days = 8.9 GPU-years. 10^4 = 89 GPU-years.
- Independent corroboration that this is not a solver-tuning problem: the longest native trajectory ever executed in this project is 40 accepted steps (ROLLING_ROADMAP.md:139), i.e. 0.3-2 s of cell time. There is no trajectory-scale forward model to train on.
=> Time-series observables are out. Only STEADY-STATE / SHORT-WINDOW observables are admissible targets, which is also what published data reports as steady state.

WHAT IS AFFORDABLE:
- Block surrogates on slices: 10 blocks x 5,000 sims = 50,000 slice-sims. At an ASSUMED (unmeasured, see P5) 30 s/slice-sim = 1.5e6 s = 17.4 GPU-days. FEASIBLE.
- Native composed adjudication set: a 3-month allocation at 50% A5000 duty = 90 x 0.5 x 86,400 = 3.888e6 GPU-seconds. At 940 s x 3 seeds (the existing GATE-A ensemble contract requires 3 cortex-construction seeds, all must pass) = 2,820 s per point => 1,378 native 3-seed points per quarter.
- 1,378 points at d_theta = 37 free is NOT enough for a joint flow, but IS enough for (i) a ~10^2-effective-parameter multi-fidelity discrepancy term and (ii) 1,378 adjudications. That is precisely the design.
- Phase 1 CRN sensitivity: 2 x 37 params + a few controls ~= 100-170 solves = 9.4e4-1.6e5 s = 26-44 h. Cheapest, highest-value item.

GRADIENT VARIANCE ARITHMETIC (the decisive number):
Discrete Bernoulli draws per accepted step at full native, all measured: NMII heads 8,840 (gate_b_dynamic_v2, 7,535 bound = 85.24%) + ERM tethers 655,362 (subdiv 8) + inter-fiber crosslinks 1,413,720 (density_per_fil = 20 x 70,686) = 2,077,922 draws/step. Over a 30-step native window: 6.23e7 draws.
- REINFORCE / score function: for a path likelihood additive over independent events, Var(grad-hat) grows linearly in the draw count, so the per-sample relative standard error is O(sqrt(N)) = sqrt(6.23e7) = 7,893. For 10% relative gradient error you need M = (7893/0.1)^2 = 6.23e9 trajectories. At even the optimistic 23.5 s/sim that is 1.46e11 s = about 4,650 GPU-years. An optimal baseline/control variate typically buys 10-100x => 46-465 GPU-years. Not a close call.
- Gumbel-softmax / straight-through: REJECTED on the hard rule before variance is considered. A relaxed bond occupancy is a mean-field fractional head; the crossbridge force is applied only on a bound head at a specific barycentric attachment point, so a fractional head has no attachment point. This is exactly the aggregate substitute ac/engine/nmii_actuator.py:460-482 refuses at construction, and exactly what I0-A calls diagnostics only, never a runtime substitute.
- Measure-valued / weak derivatives (Pflug, Heidergott): finite variance, unbiased for a rate parameter, but 2 coupled sims per parameter = 74-170 coupled solves per gradient = 7e4-1.6e5 s = 19-44 h per gradient; 10^2-10^3 gradients = 2.4-60 GPU-months. Worse than spending the same budget on block surrogates.
- Common-random-numbers finite differences: the practical winner. Freezing the Poisson uniforms makes the FD variance scale with the number of events whose accept/reject actually flips, a tiny fraction of N. Cost 2 solves/parameter. NOT usable as a surrogate gradient (still 170 solves per point), but perfect as a one-off native sensitivity instrument (Phase 1).
=> VERDICT ON GRADIENTS: no usable discrete-gradient estimator here. The sample requirement is not cut; the design must be gradient-free amortized inference.
failure_modes: THE DEEPEST TRAP: the training simulator IS a coarse configuration. The slices are reduced-population configs (sf_arc gate ran 40 fibers / 360 nodes / 320 heads; ECM ran 200-220 fibers with ZERO crosslink bonds), and the project has 6 documented M5 cases where a coarse conclusion was contradicted at native (x40 gamma ~5x; coarse crawl 28-45 vs native 0.12 nm/s; coarse treadmill collapse; CPU poroelastic finding; 8k FD proxy; fiber-quotient coarse null at native OFF 1.48 / A 1.36 / B 1.51). So the block surrogates INHERIT M5 by construction. Mitigations, all mechanical: the block output is a proposal over theta and never an observable prediction; the slice-vs-native discrepancy is MEASURED in Phase 4 and reported per observable; if discrepancy > posterior width the parameter is declared NON_INFORMATIVE and the gate refuses the claim.

OBSERVABLE DRIFT between training and adjudication. 7 documented instances of a metric measuring something other than its name, and GATE A closed after BOTH the observable (raw |F| -> projected |PF|) and the configuration (myosin seed removed) moved between a FAIL and a PASS. If the surrogate trains on one reduction and the native gate uses another, the whole program is garbage and will look fine. Mitigation: the summary vector is DEFINED BY REFERENCE to gate_contracts/*.yaml observable.id + definition, checked by string equality against the contract hash; max|PF| blacklisted outright on the measured non-grid-invariance (0.14 / 0.21 / 3.42 at 500 / 200 / 75 nm).

HASH / FINGERPRINT THEATER. Proven today: a headline fingerprint was byte-identical after dP = 40 Pa and gamma = 10 pN/um were exchanged AND the status upgraded GATED -> VALIDATED-COMPLETE, because it hashed a sorted deduplicated set of bare numeric tokens with no units. Any model_id or training_manifest hash will fail the same way if built the same way. Mitigation: canonical TYPED hash over ordered (field, unit, value) triples with units mandatory, and a MANDATORY CI negative control that performs exactly that swap and asserts the hash changes. Ship the refutation with the gate; CI fails if the negative control passes. Precedent exists: verify_gate_contracts_negcontrol.py.

INFERRED PARAMETERS LAUNDERED INTO SOURCED. The PI's long-run purpose is parameters as outputs, which is precisely the pressure that turns an inferred number into a config default and then into a citation. Mitigation: INFERRED added to forces_manifest.PROVENANCE and ranked strictly below DERIVED in verify_params.py, so a config carrying an inferred value can never be declared physiological baseline. Historical warrant: the 4.5e6x-too-soft AFINES crosslink surrogate lived as a config value for weeks.

THE SURROGATE BECOMES THE RUNTIME. The economic pressure to call the emulator inside the physics loop is exactly what produced every lumped proxy this project deletes; note FIXMAN_LAZY_EVAL_DESIGN.md:103 already REJECTED an ML surrogate (B1, Timewarp/FlashMD) on this ground. Mitigation: static import firewall enforced identically to the hoomd ban (AST scan in test_warp_only_contract.py + conftest meta_path blocker), so ac/** importing ffn_sim.infer is a hard CI failure, not a review comment.

PRIOR-DOMINATED POSTERIOR SOLD AS INFERENCE. With ~37 free parameters and ~1,400 native points, most coordinates will be prior-dominated; if the prior comes from the same literature the result is compared against, the inference is circular and will nonetheless print a tight-looking posterior. This is the single most likely route to a false claim from this design. Mitigation: mandatory per-parameter contraction report (posterior sd / prior sd); below threshold => NOT INFERRED and unquotable.

FITTING TO EXPERIMENTAL DATA. SBI is literally fitting, and the hard rule is no fitting to PI experimental data, literature-first. Mitigation: every target datum must carry a SourceEvidence id with source_audit verdict OK (177 OK of 329 audited; 3 fabricated sources already removed), checked by verify_surrogate.py, which refuses a target whose source is not in source_evidence with verdict OK. PI CSVs stay overlay-only. This needs an explicit PI ruling (P7) because it is the rule the design comes closest to breaking.

GATE THAT A BROKEN MODEL CANNOT FAIL. The project's own words: worse than an ungated result because it manufactures confidence (the largest-fragment vs second-largest connectivity gate). Today's pass returned CONFIRMED 0 of 7 on new guards. Mitigation: every gate in Phase 0 ships with a negative-control fixture; CI fails if any negative control passes; verify_surrogate.py prints a VACUOUS_CLAIM verdict for any predicate with zero applicable samples, mirroring verify_gate_contracts.py.

MANIFEST OMISSION. verify_params and verify_runs could never be wrong about what a manifest OMITS; measured consequence was both gates green while 70 params and 29 REPORT headlines were undeclared. A surrogate ledger will freeze the same way. Mitigation: extend the kb_coverage.py ratchet to surrogate claims — the undeclared set is written down with reasons and may only SHRINK; a new undeclared surrogate claim is a HARD FAIL, and a missing or unimportable coverage module makes the gate FAIL rather than skip.

UNCONVERGED LABELS. Every measured native artifact I read carries inner_converged = false (182.5 s probe, 1274.6 s probe, 163.6 s tournament, both fine-mesh runs). A surrogate trained on unconverged labels learns the relaxation transient, and its predictions will be relax-schedule-dependent exactly as T_max moved 3.4x under a 10x longer relax. Mitigation: P1/P2 are blocking; every training label must carry residual and residual/tension, and verify_surrogate.py refuses a training manifest containing any row with residual/tension above a declared cap (the 1% cap the SF gate already enforces).

WALL-TIME ANCHOR UNVERIFIED. The 938 s figure the plan is costed against is not reproducible from disk. If the real cost is 1,300 s the native adjudication budget drops ~28%; if it is 180 s it triples. Mitigation: commit a measured C_solve artifact before Phase 3 (this is P5, and it is also open question 5).
result.hard_rule_interaction:
A surrogate IS a lumped statistical proxy — the exact pattern this project deletes on sight, and one an in-tree design doc already rejected on that ground (docs/briefs/FIXMAN_LAZY_EVAL_DESIGN.md:103, option B1: violates mechanistic-only, REJECTED). So the design is admissible only if the surrogate is STRUCTURALLY INCAPABLE of being either a runtime mechanism or a measurement. Three structural facts make that true rather than intended:

(i) IT CANNOT BE A MECHANISM. It lives in ffn_sim/infer/, outside the runtime tree, behind a static import firewall enforced by the same two mechanisms that already enforce the HOOMD ban and the validation/oracles ban: an AST scan over ac/** in ffn_sim/tests/ac/test_warp_only_contract.py, and a sys.meta_path blocker in conftest.py (see _install_hoomd_blocker, conftest.py:232-279). ac/** importing ffn_sim.infer is a hard CI failure. ffn_sim/infer/ may import ac/; never the reverse.

(ii) IT CANNOT BE A MEASUREMENT. Its only public output type is a SurrogateVerdict with no scalar accessor — no .value, no .prediction. The single method that returns anything usable is .propose_native_run(), which returns a runnable native config. On OOD it raises. So the surrogate's output type is literally a native run proposal, and there is no code path by which it produces a number that reads as a measurement.

(iii) IT CANNOT BE CREDITED. Adding a REQUIRED orthogonal field evidence_origin to every claim-bearing artifact, plus the rule that declared: verified REQUIRES evidence_origin == NATIVE_CUDA, makes a surrogate claim structurally unable to reach VERIFIED in results_manifest.yaml. Note the deliberate design choice: do NOT extend verify_runs.SUSPICION (RETRACT 0 / NEEDS_REGEN 1 / GPU_UNREPRODUCED 2 / VERIFIED 3). That ladder measures disk-vs-claim drift; folding evidence origin into it would conflate two different dimensions in one scalar, which is itself the mislabel pattern (pen_frac vs INSET mean_edge, basal vs top-down A/A0). Two axes, checked independently.

INTERACTIONS WITH THE OTHER HARD RULES:
- No empirical magic numbers: every surrogate hyperparameter (flow depth, training-set size, OOD alpha, contraction threshold, adjudication ratchet 3x) is a NUMERICAL choice on an observer, not a physical constant — but each must still be declared in the artifact and justified, and none may be chosen to make a gate pass. The adjudication ratchet in particular must be declared before the first proposal, not after.
- No gate-loosening: the surrogate touches no existing gate. It proposes runs. If a surrogate result suggests a gate is wrong, that is a PI gate-contract change via contract_changes.yaml, exactly as today.
- Physiological baseline: an INFERRED parameter value ranks below DERIVED, so a config carrying one cannot be declared physiological. This directly protects the rule against the pressure created by the PI's own long-run purpose.
- Validate at FULL NATIVE population: unchanged and untouched. Every decision remains a native full-population run. The surrogate only changes WHICH native runs get spent.
- Warp-CUDA only: the surrogate trains and infers on CPU/host and is not a simulation runtime, so it does not enter the I0-A contract at all — provided (i) holds.
- No fitting to PI experimental data: this is the rule the design comes closest to breaking, because SBI is fitting. The mitigation is mechanical (targets must be SourceEvidence rows with source_audit verdict OK; PI CSVs are overlay-only) but the boundary itself needs an explicit PI ruling before any inference code exists.

The rule the PI stated — the surrogate explores, native decides — is therefore implemented as three type-system and CI facts, not as a policy. That distinction is the whole deliverable: intention-based discipline has failed 6 times here on this exact axis (M5), and the CLAUDE.md commit body for that rule already says (repeated, emphatic).
result.how_legality_is_mechanically_enforced:
Seven mechanisms, each mirroring something that already exists and works in this repo, wired blocking into make kb-check (Makefile:25, currently verify_runs --gate, verify_params --gate, verify_sources --check) and .github/workflows/ci.yml (which already runs results-gate and params-gate as separate blocking jobs).

G1 — CREDIT REFUSAL. New required orthogonal field evidence_origin on every claim-bearing artifact and every results_manifest.yaml row. verify_surrogate.py --gate exits 1 if any row has declared: verified with evidence_origin != NATIVE_CUDA. Refusal, not warning. This is the single most important line: it makes "the surrogate says X" structurally incapable of registering as a verified result.

G2 — NATIVE ANCHOR REQUIRED, SAME OBSERVABLE. For every SURROGATE-origin claim, require native_anchor_runs naming artifacts that (i) exist on disk, (ii) are stamped by verify_gate_contracts.py --stamp, and (iii) evaluated the SAME observable.id as the surrogate claim. Observable identity is checked by string equality against the gate contract's observable.id AND definition, reusing the contract-hash machinery built for M2 (4 recurrences of observable/threshold substitution, GATE A being instance 4). Fails with the leaf field named, exactly as CONTRACT_DRIFT does today.

G3 — RETRO-FIT RATCHET. Record native_minus_surrogate for every (claim, anchor) pair. FAIL if a surrogate claim's recorded prediction changed AFTER its native anchor landed without a signed row in contract_changes.yaml. This is the surrogate analogue of gate-fitting (the failure caught in-session when a verdict threshold sat just outside the measured cap value of -0.600). Predictions are write-once.

G4 — MANDATORY NEGATIVE CONTROL, IN CI. A fixture tree in which (a) a surrogate claim is promoted to verified, (b) a training-manifest observable id is silently changed, and (c) two values with the same numeric token set are swapped (dP = 40 Pa <-> gamma = 10 pN/um) must EACH make the gate RED. CI fails if any negative control passes. Precedent: verify_gate_contracts_negcontrol.py. Rationale is on the record: today's adversarial pass on seven newly-built guards returned CONFIRMED 0 of 7, so a gate must ship with its own refutation or it is decoration.

G5 — IMPORT FIREWALL (the mechanism half of "cannot be a runtime"). Extend the AST scan in ffn_sim/tests/ac/test_warp_only_contract.py so ac/** importing ffn_sim.infer is a static failure, plus a sys.meta_path blocker in conftest.py mirroring _install_hoomd_blocker (conftest.py:232-279) so it fails at import even under a dynamic import_module. Static on purpose: the verdict must not depend on what happens to be installed. Same pattern already protects hoomd and validation/oracles.

G6 — PROVENANCE DEMOTION. Add INFERRED to forces_manifest.PROVENANCE and rank it strictly below DERIVED in verify_params.py. A config carrying an INFERRED value can never be declared physiological baseline. Closes the loop the PI's own long-run purpose opens.

G7 — ADJUDICATION RATE LIMIT (the part intention-based discipline structurally lacks). surrogate_ledger.yaml records every proposal, its prediction, and its native outcome. Two numbers print on every make kb-check: adjudicated count, and worst native/surrogate ratio ever observed. HARD: unadjudicated surrogate claims may not exceed 3x the adjudicated count, else RED. The surrogate's licence to speak is throttled by native adjudication throughput — it cannot outrun the thing that checks it. Extend the kb_coverage.py ratchet to surrogate claims so the undeclared set may only shrink and a missing coverage module makes the gate FAIL rather than skip.

REFUSAL SEMANTICS INSIDE THE MODEL (fails closed, not merely audited): SurrogateVerdict has no scalar accessor; .propose_native_run() raises OutOfDistribution when log q(y) is below the alpha-quantile or when any summary coordinate is outside the training range or when the 5-member ensemble symmetric-KL exceeds the declared cap. There is no override flag, and no code path that returns a number instead.
open_questions_for_pi: The assemble_balance acceptance tolerance. A declared value exists NOWHERE in code or docs; ledger.py:329 deliberately takes it as a caller-supplied device scalar so no magic number is baked in. It gates every training label and every adjudication. This is a gate-contract decision and nothing downstream can start without it.

Is SBI against published macroscopic data a violation of no fitting to PI experimental data? Literature-first suggests not (published sources, PI CSVs stay overlay-only), but SBI IS fitting, and the whole design is an inference machine. Need an explicit ruling BEFORE any inference code exists, not after. Related: which published observables are the inference targets, and are they all SourceEvidence rows with source_audit verdict OK (the audit found 177 OK of 329, 93 CHECK)?

Does INFERRED ever become an admissible provenance for a PRODUCTION config value, or is an inferred parameter permanently a hypothesis requiring independent literature sourcing? This determines whether Phase 4 output can ever feed a run or only ever feed a paper.

The 938 s / 4.69 s-per-iteration anchor is not reproducible from any committed artifact I could find (nearest: 163.586 s for 200 accelerated iterations at 0.818 s/iter; 1274.588 s for 6000; 182.476 s for a 400-iteration full-compartment outer step). Which run produced it? The economics of the entire design scale linearly on it, and a design costed against an unverifiable wall-time number is the failure class this audit exists for.

Ratify the EXPLORER/DECIDER speed asymmetry: FIX1 (cg_check_every, bit-identical, 5.3x) may accelerate both; FIX2 (assembled per-fiber coarse, NOT bit-identical, unratified) may accelerate the training set only and must never accelerate an adjudication. Without this ruling the 40x figure is unusable for planning.

Priority ordering. Phase 1 (CRN sensitivity: 170 native solves, ~44 h, no neural network) may show the effective dimension is 10-15 and REJECT Phases 3-5 outright, replacing them with a direct native sweep. It also produces immediately usable magnitude-free results (parameter X provably does not affect observable Y => retire X from the gate without sourcing it). Run it first even though it delays the surrogate by ~3 weeks?

Hardware. The design is hardware-bound, not idea-bound: one A5000 at 50% duty gives ~1,378 native 3-seed adjudication points per quarter, and that number is what caps the whole program. Is a dedicated allocation available, or does this justify second GPU hardware (which CLAUDE.md already names as the sanctioned response to native pressure)?

Slice-sim wall time is unmeasured anywhere on disk. The 17.4-GPU-day block-training estimate assumes 30 s/slice-sim. Authorise a measurement pass on the sf_arc / cortex_motor / erm slices before committing to Phase 3?

GlobalCellLedger moment + centroid channels: adding them is a ledger contract change and ecm_world.py:346 already promises to contribute a moment the ledger cannot accept. They are prerequisite to any traction-dipole or translocation observable. Authorise as part of Phase 2, or as its own card?

instruments.name: A/A0 "top-down xy silhouette" — the PI-ratified spreading metric
instruments.where: SIX independent copies, all identical in kind: ffn_sim/scripts/dcm_native_spread.py:48-54 (_silhouette); ffn_sim/dcm/dcm_warp_decohesion.py:247-256 (_topdown_area_um2); ffn_sim/scripts/dcm_two_stage_production.py:71-86 (_topdown_area); ffn_sim/scripts/lamel_validate_cpu.py:32-40 (_topdown_area); ffn_sim/scripts/lamel_gpu_validate.py:30-37 (_topdown); ffn_sim/scripts/h7_dcm_spheroid_spread.py:33-38 (_footprint_um2)
instruments.what_its_name_implies: The projected shadow of the cell viewed from above — the area a microscope would measure in a top-down spreading assay.
instruments.what_it_actually_measures: The area of the 2D CONVEX HULL of the node xy-coordinates. Every one of the six copies is literally `ConvexHull(pos[:, :2]).volume`. A convex hull is the smallest convex set containing the points; a silhouette is the union of the projected surface. They agree only for shapes that are convex in projection.
instruments.evidence: Measured on a lobed adherent cell (icosphere subdiv 4, z-flattened 4x, radial modulation 1+amp*cos(n*theta)), node-hull vs true facet-union silhouette (1400x1400 raster of the union of xy-projected triangles): 3 lobes amp .35 -> hull/true = 1.136; 5 lobes amp .35 -> 1.385; 8 lobes amp .35 -> 1.555; 5 lobes amp .60 -> 1.726; 8 lobes amp .60 -> 1.983. The convex hull OVERSTATES the silhouette by 14-98% for exactly the morphologies that spreading produces (lamellipodial lobes, ruffles, protrusions). Single-outlier test: adding ONE node 15 um beyond an otherwise perfect sphere raises the hull 176.490 -> 266.441 um^2 (+50.97%) while the true added area is 0 — a single escaped/blown-up node reads as 51% spreading. Worse, `convex-hull` is ITSELF in the FORBIDDEN_METRICS set (ffn_sim/outputs/tag_kb/verify_runs.py:95-96) and ffn_sim/tests/ac/test_kb_integrity_gates.py:121-124 asserts it must RETRACT — so the sanctioned implementation of the sanctioned metric is a member of the forbidden set. THREE MUTUALLY INCONSISTENT FALLBACKS hide behind one name, all reached by a bare `except Exception`: 0.0 (dcm_warp_decohesion, lamel_validate_cpu, lamel_gpu_validate, h7_dcm_spheroid_spread), ptp(x)*ptp(y) = bounding box (dcm_two_stage_production:86, x1.275 on the same nodes), pi/4*ptp(x)*ptp(y) (dcm_native_spread:54, x1.001). A scipy hiccup silently changes the metric DEFINITION rather than raising.
instruments.canonical_replacement: A_sil := area of the union of the xy-projections of the MEMBRANE mesh triangles (exact via polygon union, or raster with a stated cell size and a stated convergence check), computed on the membrane surface only, in um^2. If the component has no closed surface (filament cortex), define A_sil on the membrane component and never on a node cloud. Never a hull; never a bounding box; the `except` clause must RAISE.
instruments.negative_control_that_would_catch_it: (a) Build a star/lobed shape with a known analytic projected area and assert the instrument returns it to <1%; a hull fails by 14-98%. (b) Add one node at 2R along +x and assert A changes by < 1e-3 relative; a hull fails by +51%. (c) Force the `except` branch (pass 2 collinear points) and assert it RAISES rather than returning a different definition.

Mean thickness V/A_silhouette = 3.02 / 2.83 / 2.95 um versus a reported height of 16.01 / 15.63 / 15.10 um, a 5x inconsistency. Sphericity = 0.322 / 0.324 / 0.322. Separately, the A0 denominator carries a pure mesh bias: A0/piR^2 = 0.97996 / 0.99493 / 0.99873 (my independent icosphere hull computation reproduces 173.1739 / 175.8180 / 176.4897 um^2 to 5 significant figures), so A0 is 2.0% low at subdiv 2. Convexity was NOT the error here (hull/true = 1.000/1.005/1.005 for these final shapes) — the error is that A/A0 has no height, no surface-area and no thickness companion in the gate, so shadow growth and spreading are indistinguishable.
instruments.canonical_replacement: Never report A/A0 alone. A spreading claim must be a TUPLE gated jointly: (A_sil/A_sil0, h_mean = V/A_sil, A_surf/A_surf0 with its declared reservoir cap, V/V0). Assert h_mean strictly decreases and A_surf/A_surf0 stays inside the reservoir cap; otherwise report 'area inflation, not spreading'.
instruments.negative_control_that_would_catch_it: Assert that a state with UNCHANGED z-extent cannot pass a spreading gate. Equivalently: gate on h_mean = V/A_sil and require h_mean_final < 0.5 * h_mean_initial. The committed runs give h_mean ~2.9 um against an initial 2R/1.5 ~ 10 um so they would pass THAT — but they fail the z-extent control (15.00 -> 15.10-16.01), which is precisely why both must be present.

instruments.name: cortex_node_areal_strain (the per-node deformation field used to colour the visual-verification viewers)
instruments.what_its_name_implies: Per-node areal strain of the cortex surface — where the cortex is locally stretched or compressed.
instruments.what_it_actually_measures: The area change of a 3D CONVEX HULL triangulation of the cortex node cloud, averaged onto the hull's vertices only. Nodes touched by no hull face get acc/max(cnt,1) = 0/1 = exactly 0.0. The hull triangles also connect nodes that are NOT mechanically bonded (different filaments), so the quantity is not a material strain of anything.
instruments.evidence: Measured on a physiological 0.2 um cortical shell (radii uniform in [7.20, 7.40], the overlap_free_cortex geometry): at the NATIVE 494,802 nodes the hull yields 22,022 faces touching 11,013 nodes = 2.23% coverage, so 97.77% of nodes report areal strain EXACTLY 0.0 by construction. Under a uniform 5% radial dilation the TRUE areal strain is 0.1025; the reported mean over all nodes is 0.0023 = 2.2% of truth (a 45x underestimate), while the mean over covered nodes is exactly 0.1025. The underestimate is a pure grid artifact and gets WORSE with refinement: coverage 35.65% at N=2,000 -> 11.23% at 20,000 -> 4.91% at 100,000 -> 2.246% at 494,802 -> 1.440% at 1.2M -> 0.921% at the fine 2.9M mesh; fitted exponent -0.504, i.e. the reported mean areal strain scales as N^(-1/2). At the PI's fine 75 nm mesh 99.1% of nodes would report zero strain. The project's own code admits the sliver problem: ffn_sim/scripts/ff_s2_local_load_viewer.py:129 'degenerate outliers merely saturate. (A cleaner fix filters degenerate faces in cortex_node_areal_strain.)'; measured face-area spread max/median = 4.6x at N=2,000 rising to 6.1x at native. This field is what the PI's per-stage visualization gate renders, so the visual bug-catching checkpoint is instrumented with a field that is structurally zero on 98-99% of the cell.
instruments.canonical_replacement: Define deformation on the actual mechanical topology, not a hull: per-SEGMENT axial stretch lambda_e = |x_i - x_j| / r0_ij over the real bond list (intra-filament segments and crosslinks separately), reported as a distribution and as a per-node average over incident BONDS. Every node has bonds, so coverage is 100% and the quantity is grid-invariant because it is a ratio of the same bond's current to rest length. For genuine surface areal strain, use the membrane component's own triangulation with its own rest areas.
instruments.negative_control_that_would_catch_it: Apply a uniform affine dilation x -> (1+e)x and assert the reported MEAN strain equals (1+e)^2 - 1 to within 1%, at both 494,802 and 2.9M nodes. Today it returns 2.2% and 0.9% of the correct value respectively — an immediate, unambiguous failure.

instruments.name: mem_areal_strain (membrane areal strain, the input to the membrane area-elasticity law)
instruments.where: ffn_sim/ff/network_warp.py:989-991 (`(area_mem - _mm.A0)/_mm.A0`); the reference is set at ffn_sim/ff/membrane_surface.py:58 (`A0 = float(4.0 * np.pi * R_mem ** 2)`); law described at ffn_sim/common/compartments.py:12
instruments.what_its_name_implies: Fractional areal stretch of the plasma membrane relative to its unstressed reference area — zero when nothing has deformed.
instruments.what_it_actually_measures: (sum of triangle areas of the discrete icosphere minus the CONTINUUM 4*pi*R^2) / 4*pi*R^2. Numerator and denominator use different surfaces, so the metric is NEGATIVE at zero physical strain by an amount set purely by mesh resolution.
instruments.evidence: Measured directly on the icosphere at R = 7.5 um: mem_areal_strain at ZERO strain = -0.01882 (subdiv 2), -0.00476 at the CODE DEFAULT subdiv 3 (ac/cell/assemble.py membrane_subdivisions: int = 3), -0.00119 (4), -0.00030 (5), -0.00007 (6), -0.00002 (7), -0.0000004 (8 = the PI-ratified production resting config). So refining the membrane from the code default to production changes the reported 'areal strain' of an undeformed membrane by 0.48 percentage points with zero physics change. With K_A = 0.13 N/m the spurious strain corresponds to a spurious tension of -6.2e-4 N/m at subdiv 3 and -2.4e-3 N/m at subdiv 2 (~6% and ~24% of the MCF7 cortical tension scale 1e-2 N/m); at the default f_excess = 0.25 reservoir this sits inside the plateau so the FORCE consequence is currently masked, but f_excess is itself PI-blocked/unknown (ffn_sim/common/compartments.py:246-248), so the masking is not a guarantee. The project already knows the rule and states it in the other engine: ffn_sim/ac/cell/assemble.py:922-930 uses the DISCRETE `signed_volume(mem_verts, membrane.mesh.faces)` and explains 'The live triangular membrane, not the analytic sphere used to seed it, is the actual discrete closed domain... mixing the analytic sphere volume with the triangle pressure load creates a deterministic internal net force.' ff/membrane_surface.py:58 is the same mistake that comment forbids.
instruments.canonical_replacement: A0 := triangle_surface_area(verts0, faces) of the SAME mesh at the reference configuration (discrete-to-discrete), stored alongside the mesh, in um^2. Then mem_areal_strain == 0 exactly at build for every subdivision level.
instruments.negative_control_that_would_catch_it: Assert mem_areal_strain == 0.0 to within 1e-12 immediately after build, parametrized over membrane_subdivisions in {2..8}. Today it returns -0.0188 to -4e-7.

instruments.name: V_hull / V_over_V0 / cell surface `area` — the enclosed cell volume in the ff runtime, and the driver of osmotic turgor
instruments.where: ffn_sim/ff/network_warp.py:830-835 (V0 = ConvexHull(net.pos).volume - V_nuc; A0_mem = ConvexHull(net.pos).area; _cortex_faces = _oriented_hull_faces(net.pos)), :648-658 (_oriented_hull_faces), :918 (_rehull_every = 5), :1016-1036 (periodic re-hull + divergence volume/area), :1056-1064 (V_cyto = V - V_nuc feeds dP_solid and dP_osm), :1288 / :1439 / :1797 (reported as V_over_V0, V_hull_um3), :751 (nucleus V0_nuc likewise a hull), :1156, :1699, :1743
instruments.what_its_name_implies: The cell's enclosed volume and surface area — and, downstream, the physiological osmotic turgor pressure computed from the volume change.
instruments.what_it_actually_measures: The volume and area of the CONVEX HULL of the cortex node cloud, re-hulled every 5 turgor refreshes. Any concave feature — bleb neck, lamellipodial notch, trailing edge, indentation dimple, spread-cell ruffle — is bridged over and therefore invisible. This is not only an observable: dP_solid = K_drained*max(0,(V0-V_cyto)/V0) and dP_osm both key off it, so a geometric definition error propagates into the force field.
instruments.evidence: Measured with 200,000 nodes on a sphere R = 7.5 um. Convex cases are fine (hull V = 1767.04 vs exact 1767.15, -0.006%; a FLAT-plate indentation stays convex so hull/true = 0.9999 at every depth 0.5-3.0 um). The failures need concavity: a 5-lobed non-convex cell (crawl / lamellipodium / spread ruffle) gives hull/true = 1.166 / 1.383 / 1.593 for amp 0.20 / 0.35 / 0.50 (+16.6% / +38.3% / +59.3% overstated volume). A hemispherical bleb of radius a gives hull/true = 1.0010 / 1.0039 / 1.0141 / 1.0294 for a = 0.5 / 1 / 2 / 3 um — the hull invents volume in the neck. A SPHERICAL AFM tip (the concave case) is the sharpest: at R_tip = 2.5 um, depth 2.0 um the TRUE volume loss is 17.35 um^3 but the hull sees only 3.37 um^3 — the hull captures 19% of the compression signal, so the osmotic turgor rise is understated ~5.1x (at R_tip = 5.0, depth 2.0: 37% captured, 2.7x understated). Critically, this error does NOT converge under mesh refinement — it is definitional, not a discretization artifact. The existing self-check is a same-definition tautology: ffn_sim/ff/network_warp.py:831 comments '(divergence on _cortex_faces == ConvexHull, validated)' — two implementations of the SAME hull definition were cross-validated; neither was ever checked against the actual enclosed volume of the cortex or membrane surface. The other engine does it correctly (ac/cell/assemble.py:925-930, discrete signed_volume of the membrane mesh), so the two engines' 'cell volume' are different quantities.
instruments.canonical_replacement: V := signed_volume(membrane_verts, membrane_faces) via the divergence theorem on the ACTUAL closed membrane triangulation (already implemented at ffn_sim/ac/cell/membrane_pressure.py:124-129), um^3; A_surf := triangle_surface_area of the same mesh, um^2. For the cortex (a filament network with no closed surface) do not define an enclosed volume at all — the enclosing surface is the membrane component's, obtained through the membrane<->cortex connector.
instruments.negative_control_that_would_catch_it: Construct a shape with an analytically known non-convex volume (a sphere minus a spherical cap; a 5-lobed star with V = int pi(R^2-z^2)(1+amp^2/2)dz) and assert the instrument returns it to <1%. The hull fails by 17-59%. Second control: indent with a SPHERICAL tip and assert dV_measured / dV_true > 0.95; the hull returns 0.19-0.37.

instruments.name: nuclear flattening: z_half_um and z_flatten_frac
instruments.where: ffn_sim/scripts/ff_internal_displacement_diag.py:106-120 (shape(): z_half_um = float(np.abs(p[:,2]).max()) with p = pos - pos.mean(0); z_flatten_frac = (z_rest - z_load)/z_rest), reported at :151-153; cited as the 0.0% flattening evidence in ffn_sim/docs/v2_audit/ARCHITECTURE_COMPLETENESS_2026-07-25.md:25 and ffn_sim/docs/v2_audit/INTERNAL_DISPLACEMENT_DIAGNOSIS_2026-07-16.md:17
instruments.what_its_name_implies: The nucleus's half-thickness along the compression axis, and the fractional flattening under load.
instruments.what_it_actually_measures: The maximum |z| of any nucleus node relative to the nucleus centroid — a single-node EXTREMUM of the z-EXTENT, not a thickness. It is invariant to rigid translation (good) but NOT to rigid rotation of the nucleus, and it is dominated by whichever one node happens to be farthest in z.
instruments.evidence: z_half is max|z - z_mean| over 3000 nucleus beads: a max is non-smooth, discontinuous in the argmax, and mesh-convergent from below (a discrete mesh only attains R if a vertex sits at the pole; the reported 5.106 um for R_nuc = 0.68*R0 ~ 5.03-5.10 um is consistent with the extremal-vertex value, not a mean). The companion 'frozen' verdict uses an undeclared tolerance: `interior_frozen = (raw_std_um < 0.01) and (...)` at :119 — 10 nm, with no derivation anywhere.
instruments.canonical_replacement: Report the nuclear shape as the three eigenvalues of the mass-weighted second-moment (gyration) tensor of the envelope vertices, and define aspect := sqrt(lambda_1/lambda_3) with the flattening axis IDENTIFIED from the eigenvector rather than assumed to be z. Dimensionless; rotation-covariant; smooth; every vertex contributes. Add h_nuc := V_nuc / A_projected_nuc as the physical mean thickness (um). Keep z-extent only as a secondary diagnostic, labelled 'extent', never 'half-thickness'.
instruments.negative_control_that_would_catch_it: Apply a random rigid rotation to the nucleus state and assert every flattening observable is unchanged to 1e-10. z_half fails. Second control: apply a known affine oblate flatten (aspect 1 -> 1.5 at constant volume) and assert the instrument recovers 1.5 to <1% — the closed form already exists at ffn_sim/ac/nucleus/linc_analytic.py:99-114 (a = (3V0*A/4pi)^(1/3), A = height_ratio^(-3/2)) and is completely unused as an acceptance oracle.

instruments.name: cell height_um = z.max() - z.min()

instruments.what_its_name_implies: The cell's height above the substrate — the flattening signal in a spreading assay.
instruments.what_it_actually_measures: The difference of two single-node extrema. One escaped node, one mesh spike, or one un-relaxed bead sets it.
instruments.evidence: In the committed spreading runs the extremum height moves 16.01 -> 15.63 -> 15.10 um across subdiv 2/3/4 with identical physics — a 6% pure resolution effect — while the robust p99-p1 version gives 15.95 / 15.00 / 14.34 um, a 10% spread, and the physically meaningful mean thickness V/A_sil gives 3.02 / 2.83 / 2.95 um, a completely different number. instruments.name: per-node displacement |Delta| (the deformation-coupling observable)
instruments.where: ffn_sim/scripts/ff_internal_displacement_diag.py:86-89 (disp = (pos_load - c_load) - (pos_rest - c_rest); raw = pos_load - pos_rest), :95-99 (per-compartment mean/p50/max); its output is the load-bearing evidence in ffn_sim/docs/v2_audit/ARCHITECTURE_COMPLETENESS_2026-07-25.md:25 ('cortex deformed 39.8 nm mean / 751 nm max while nucleus displacement was 0.0 nm')
instruments.what_its_name_implies: Internal DEFORMATION kinematics — how much each compartment actually deforms under load.
instruments.what_it_actually_measures: Displacement with rigid TRANSLATION removed (via the cortex centroid) but rigid ROTATION not removed. Any whole-body or per-compartment rotation between the rest and load states enters as deformation. The two states are also two INDEPENDENT relaxations (run_state called twice, :76 and :81), so each state's own un-converged residual displacement is included in the difference.
instruments.evidence: For a rigid rotation by angle theta about the centroid of a shell of radius R, the centroid-referenced |Delta| is exactly |R_rot x - x| = 2 R_perp sin(theta/2), whose mean over a sphere is (pi/4) R theta. The reported cortex mean of 39.8 nm at R = 7.4 um corresponds to theta = 39.8e-3 / (0.785 * 7.4) = 6.85e-3 rad = 0.39 degrees. So the entire headline deformation signal is within the noise of an unremoved 0.4-degree rigid rotation, and nothing in the instrument excludes one. The 'frozen' classifier at :119 uses an undeclared 0.01 um threshold. Removing rotation is a solved problem (Kabsch/Procrustes) and is absent.
instruments.canonical_replacement: Delta := x_load - (Q x_rest + t) where (Q, t) is the optimal rigid transform (Kabsch, no scaling) fitted PER COMPARTMENT over that compartment's own nodes; report mean/p50/p95/max of |Delta| in nm plus the fitted rotation angle and translation as separate reported channels so the rigid part is visible instead of hidden. Additionally report the strain invariants (per-bond lambda_e distribution) which are rigid-motion-invariant by construction.
instruments.negative_control_that_would_catch_it: Apply a random rigid rotation + translation to the whole loaded state and assert every displacement statistic is unchanged to 1e-10 nm. The current instrument returns (pi/4)*R*theta ~ 131 nm for theta = 1 degree, i.e. 3.3x the headline signal it is used to establish.

instruments.name: cortex connectivity / percolation gate
instruments.where: ffn_sim/scripts/engine_reval.py:539-557 (percolates = giant >= 0.60 and (second < 1e-9 or giant/max(second,1e-9) > 10.0)), :561-593 (_component_stats union-find over intra-fiber segments + crosslink + myosin edges); the build claim it is supposed to support is at ffn_sim/ac/engine/forces_manifest.py:516-518 ('20 keeps the network single-spanning (percolation fix 2026-07-23; degree-2 at 1.0 fragmented it)') and ffn_sim/ac/cell/assemble.py:224-230
instruments.what_its_name_implies: The assembled cortex is a SINGLE spanning mesh, not fragmented — the invariant the density_per_fil = 20 CONVENIENCE constant exists to satisfy.
instruments.what_it_actually_measures: Two RELATIVE conditions: the largest component holds >= 60% of nodes, AND the largest is >10x the second-largest. `n_components` is computed and REPORTED but never asserted. A build consisting of one 60%-giant plus eleven thousand tiny fragments satisfies both clauses.
instruments.evidence: The historically fragmented build (11,430 components, per the 2026-07-23 percolation fix) is exactly the configuration this gate cannot fail: with a dominant giant, giant/second is enormous regardless of how many fragments exist. The gate's own docstring at :523-525 states the criterion as 'giant component >= 99% of nodes' while the code enforces 0.60 — the gate is 39 percentage points looser than its stated contract, and the note at :557 records the accepted value as 'giant ~0.84'. Worse for the canonical engine: grepping ffn_sim/tests/ac/ and ffn_sim/ac/ finds NO connectivity or percolation measurement at all — the single-spanning property that justifies cortex_density_per_fil = 20 is claimed in a comment and measured nowhere in ac/.

Report the giant fraction and n_components as diagnostics, and gate only on (1) and (2). If dangling filament ends are physically expected outside the giant, define the gate on the 2-core (iteratively strip degree-1 nodes) so the dangling ends are excluded by construction instead of by a tolerance.
instruments.negative_control_that_would_catch_it: Feed the gate the KNOWN-fragmented build (density_per_fil = 1.0, 11,430 components) and assert it FAILS. Today it passes. Also feed it a deliberately severed cortex (delete all crosslinks in one hemisphere) and assert failure.
